ArenaLab update v1
version: 1.1.1
kind: hotfix
note: Fonts: opening a .fntpck no longer redraws it with whatever typeface is selected. It kept the file's own letters only for logos; the text font was rebuilt with Bebas Neue, so opening and exporting without touching anything replaced your font. Open and export now returns the very same file, byte for byte.
note: Fonts: the letter grid says whether the letters are the file's own or freshly drawn.
note: Fonts: after exporting, the app warns if the font was saved outside your open folders, or if no text in the open project points at it -- the two reasons a custom font silently does nothing in game.
